correctness.rationale: The complete Fisher list is checked against F and Hess(F), and 2024 of 2024 exact cyclotomic triple determinants have nonzero norms supported only on 2 and 7. Therefore for every prime p>=5 other than 7 the 24 lines remain pairwise distinct and never concur three at a point. Smoothness is proved by the gradient linear system determinant 28; the 24 reduced Hessian intersections exhaust the Bezout bound. Exact six-element Galois permutations on the line pairs yield 3 fixed rational pairs, 7 three-orbits, 42 six-orbits; Frobenius and Dirichlet give all rational counts and prime densities. Standalone exact Python verifier returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The 24 inflection tangent lines form the intrinsic flex configuration of the unusually symmetric Klein genus-3 curve. Their universally ordinary intersection lattice for every good prime and complete 276-point Galois/Frobenius orbit classification are natural exact arithmetic invariants. They are neither a routine reading of the source flex counts nor an arbitrary finite cutoff: the 2024-triple norm analysis proves an all-prime structural stability theorem and rational incidence counts.
